description: Unified AI Model Access HiAPI is a developer-first platform designed to simplify the integration of diverse AI capabilities. By providing a single API key, the platform allows developers to access a wide range of image, video, music, and text generation models without managing multiple separate integrations. This unified approach streamlines the development workflow for modern AI applications. Built for AI Agents and Coding Tools The platform is specifically engineered for compatibility with AI
